close_reason: Added expandRecurrences and recurrenceOverrides backend contract docs to CalendarsBackend trait; cargo doc shows 0 new warnings
description:
**What:** Add explicit documentation of two backend contracts that are currently implicit/undocumented. Oracle: §5.11 (expandRecurrences), §5.9.1 (recurrenceOverrides two-level patch).

**Algorithm:**
1. Add CalendarQueryError enum with expandDurationTooLarge and cannotCalculateOccurrences variants. Update handle_calendar_event_query to map these to correct JMAP error responses.
2. Add doc comment block to handle_calendar_event_set citing §5.9.1: explains two-level patch semantics pass-through to backend.
3. Add unit test: patch key 'recurrenceOverrides/2025-03-05T09:00:00/status' reaches MockBackend.update_object with the key preserved unchanged (handler must not mangle it).
4. In CalendarsBackend doc comment: document expandRecurrences, synthetic ids, cannotCalculateOccurrences requirements. Oracle: §5.11.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- CalendarQueryError variants documented with spec citations.
- Patch key passthrough test passes.
- cargo test -p jmap-calendars-server exits 0.
title: Document expandRecurrences and recurrenceOverrides backend contracts
